title: A backdated live search is not a point-in-time backtest
detail: Re-running a live news index with a past cut-off loses the articles that dropped out of feeds; ~20 sentiment scores moved (Reconciliation cause 1).
suggested_change: Past as-of date -> dated archive (GDELT) via --news auto; a live index with a past date is refused or stamped.

title: Sentiment needs the 12-month evidence window, not only the latest weeks
detail: With only the last 2-6 weeks nothing can reach +2 and a 40% revenue fall cannot reach -1.
suggested_change: Added a separate 12-month results pass and measured the evidence span per stock.

title: Appointments, promotions and succession are never a management exit
detail: Seven penalties were direction errors (AIA, 3M, Dr Reddy's, Titan, Nestle, AU SFB, Hindustan Copper).
suggested_change: Verification gate + text safety net for people items.

title: The company must be the subject of a penalised event
detail: Macro duty hike, sector rule, compliance statement and a defrauded bank were penalised as company regulatory action / investigation.
suggested_change: Subject / victim / macro rules in the gate.

title: Immaterial sums sit in the -5 procedural band
detail: Rs 1.64 cr (Eicher) and Rs 64 lakh (Bank of Maharashtra) were scored at the -20 weight.
suggested_change: Rs 10 cr materiality floor for non-integrity matters; integrity-type (SEBI conduct) exempt.

title: One real-world event is one event, even when reported on several days / as several types
detail: Nestle's FSSAI notice (14-Jun) and 'probe' (15-Jun) were both penalised; the real model later gave them different wording and keys.
suggested_change: Same-event de-duplication within a family (7 days, shared distinctive words or key); different families (fraud probe vs CFO termination) stay separate.

title: Share-price moves never feed sentiment
detail: The July output cited 52-week highs, % moves and sell-offs as evidence.
suggested_change: price_move event type, prompt rule, and a lint that strips price sentences from sentiment commentary.

title: Report Insufficient Data rather than a forced +1 or 0
detail: Below 8 relevant articles, or with no results print in 12 months, sentiment was being forced.
suggested_change: Minimum evidence standard in the rubric.

title: A holding must never appear or disappear silently
detail: JB Chemicals vanished from the team run's universe (30 -> 29).
suggested_change: Universe hash locked against the last confirmed run; --confirm-universe / --expect-count.

title: The -5 memory discount applies only when nothing in the window was penalised
detail: Kajaria's memory discount was kept alongside in-window penalties.
suggested_change: Convention in the rubric and code.

title: One corporate action per declaration
detail: 375 headlines (141 dividend) were counted as separate actions.
suggested_change: Collapse repeat headlines by type + figures within a window.

title: When two implementations differ, take the union of verified evidence and re-score once
detail: Averaging or picking a side hides the real disagreement.
suggested_change: `sentinelq merge` + portfolio/verified_events.csv; verified events reproduce the reconciled scores.
